Local Medicare & insurance help for Vienna

Our office is minutes away in Tysons, at 8609 Westwood Center Drive, Suite 110. We help Vienna neighbors sort through Medicare and insurance options the honest way: no pressure, no jargon, and no cost to you. You can meet with us in person by appointment, we can come to you, or we can handle everything by phone — whatever fits your schedule.

Our guidance is free because the insurance carriers pay us a commission when we place a policy. By law, your premium is exactly the same whether you work with us or sign up on your own — so there's no reason to go it alone. We simply compare your options, explain the tradeoffs in plain English, and stay reachable after you enroll.

Schedule a Medicare review

Booking opens Luay’s page on PlanEnroll. Create your profile there and ask for your meeting. Having these ready makes the first conversation useful:

  • Your Medicare card, or the dates your Part A and Part B start.
  • The doctors and hospitals you want to keep.
  • A list of your prescriptions and the pharmacy you use.
  • Whether you have Medicaid or get help paying Medicare costs.

When PlanEnroll asks what type of meeting you would like, choose Health. You may be asked to complete a short Scope of Appointment form first. It does not obligate you to enroll. The first open time is at least 24 hours ahead. To talk sooner, call (301) 615-8289 or text (571) 354-0146.

Coverage we offer Vienna residents

  • Medicare Advantage — all-in-one Part C plans, with premiums, networks and benefits that vary by plan.
  • Medicare Supplement (Medigap) — see any doctor nationwide that accepts Medicare.
  • Part D drug plans — we compare the total yearly cost for your medication list.
  • final expense — cover funeral and end-of-life costs for your family.
  • life insurance — protect the people who depend on you.
  • annuities — guaranteed, predictable retirement income.
  • ACA (under 65) — Marketplace health plans for those not yet on Medicare.
  • ICHRA — individual coverage health reimbursement arrangements for employers.

We also help with cancer and critical illness coverage, dental, vision and hearing coverage and hospital indemnity coverage.

Knowing Vienna's doctors and hospitals

From our office minutes away in Tysons, we know this part of Fairfax County well — from Maple Avenue running through the heart of town to the Washington & Old Dominion (W&OD) Trail that cuts across it, and the short hop over to Tysons. We also know where Vienna residents go for care: this area is served by the Inova health system, with the Inova Fairfax Medical Campus nearby.

That local knowledge matters with Medicare. On a Medicare Advantage plan, the provider network is everything — a plan only works for you if your doctors and hospitals are in it. Before you enroll, we verify that your Vienna-area doctors and the Inova facilities you rely on are actually covered, so you're not surprised later. If keeping any provider matters more to you, we'll walk through how a Medigap plan lets you see any doctor that accepts Medicare instead.

Networks change by neighborhood: Medicare Advantage networks and plan availability differ even within Fairfax County. We check what's available and in-network at your specific Vienna address — including nearby Oakton and Dunn Loring — before you commit to anything.

Common questions

Vienna Medicare FAQ

Can I meet with a Vienna Medicare agent in person?
Yes — by appointment. Our office is minutes away in Tysons at 8609 Westwood Center Drive, so we can meet in person, come to you, or handle everything by phone — whatever is easiest for you.
Will my Vienna-area doctors and hospitals be covered?
On a Medicare Advantage plan it depends on the plan's network, so before you enroll we verify your specific providers — including Inova facilities like the nearby Inova Fairfax Medical Campus — are in network. With a Medigap plan, you can see any doctor or hospital that accepts Medicare.
Do you charge Vienna residents for help?
No, our help is free. Carriers pay us a commission when we place a policy, and by law your premium is the same whether you use an agent or enroll on your own.
When can I enroll or change plans?
During your Initial Enrollment Period around your 65th birthday, during the Annual Enrollment Period (Oct 15 – Dec 7), or during a Special Enrollment Period — for example, when you move to or within Vienna.

One honest call can make all the difference.
